pick.name: Mermaid
pick.what: Text-to-diagram in Markdown (flowchart, sequence, ER, state, Gantt)
pick.why: Claude writes it fluently, GitHub/most docs render it natively, diffs in Git.
pick.free_limits: Free; Mermaid Chart (mermaid.ai) free tier 3-6 diagrams, 15 AI credits

alts.name: D2
alts.what: Modern diagram language with better auto-layout
alts.why: Prettier architecture diagrams than Mermaid; needs a binary.

alts.name: PlantUML
alts.install: brew install plantuml | choco install plantuml | apt install plantuml, or download plantuml.jar (needs Java)

candidates.name: archify skill
candidates.verdict: interactive HTML architecture diagrams from text/Mermaid

decision: Mermaid renders on GitHub with no tooling and Claude rarely gets it wrong. Use D2 for polished architecture images, archify for interactive client-facing diagrams.

verify.note: Shallow check only: free/commercial terms are consistent with the cited licence; not re-opened in this pass.
